review_method: Verified source manifests, RGB/trace clocks/actions, unchanged normal collection configuration, and visually inspected ten representative frames per trial covering each sleeve HOLD beginning/middle/end, planned-release followup, start and final. No fault injection or recovery executed.
visual_findings: Across all three trials, sleeve corners visibly follow the intended hand during representative lift/transfer frames; no gross detachment is visible in those samples.
Planned releases are supported by command events and subsequent images, excluded from HOLD model fitting and calibration.
Final images show folded cloth; recorded region proxy is not used as proof of local grasp or full product quality.
limitations: Sampled images do not establish continuous contact or rule out subtle transient slip/occlusion.
These are near-identical scripted repetitions; one calibration trial cannot establish a statistical false alarm guarantee.
Normality is a bounded development assumption supported by logs and visual samples; not Hu or human independent acceptance.
The heldout trial is used once for development reporting; no threshold selection or hyperparameter tuning uses it.
